<inclusion_criteria>
A systematic search identified studies whose title or abstract matches all three of: an included gauge (e.g. "Widget Durability Scale"); a term for load-bearing widgets (e.g. "structural bracket"); and a term for a lifecycle outcome (e.g. "warranty cost", "mean time to failure").

To be included, a study must:
- be conducted on a load-bearing widget class, or report an analysis in a load-bearing subgroup;
- assess units with one of the durability gauges listed above;
- be a full-text journal article, technical report, or standards body publication carrying original results (pre-prints and conference papers were excluded);
- be published or available in English.

Each included paper must also report, in the main text or in the tables and figures it carries, at least one statistical relationship between a gauge score and one of: maintenance cost or resource use; expected service life; or probability of transition between the failure states used in reliability appraisal (commissioning, stable service, scheduled maintenance, degraded operation, unplanned removal, end of life).

The relationship must be reported *within* a load-bearing widget population, not by comparing load-bearing units to decorative or non-structural ones.
</inclusion_criteria>
